messages:
alice: heads-up — noticed a weird noise floor on the GPU provisioning / headroom panels for us-west this morning. queue depth jumps that don't match incoming request rate.
autoscale-bot: alert gpu_pool_headroom_low fired for cluster-us-west-2 (3x in 12m) — docs: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/alerts
tariq: thanks, saw that too. looks like batch_size distribution shifted; infer nodes are getting more small requests, causing inefficient packing and odd queue spikes.
maria: can you paste the queries? i want to see whether it's queue depth or a prom scrape artifact.
alice: here's what i'm looking at: PromQL ->
```
sum(rate(rq_queue_depth{region="us-west"}[1m])) by (pool)
sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region="us-west"}[1m])) by (model)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
kevin: fwiw our scrape latency spiked at 03:10UTC but only for the metrics exporter; node-level metrics look fine. could be exporter GC + big bump in small inference calls.
jon: interesting — the headroom panel uses a raw windowed avg which amplifies short bursts. we should switch to a 5m quantile + increase debounce on the alert.
tariq: proposal: change alert from absolute queue depth > 50 to:
```
(max_over_time(sum(rq_queue_depth{region="us-west"}[5m])[5m:1m])) > 20 and
increase(rate(inference_requests_total[5m]) > 0.1)
```
and add a suppression if batch_size_95 < 4 (i.e., mostly single-token calls cause noise)
maria: i like that. also add a panel showing batch_size heatmap per model so SRE/product can see workload mix.
kevin: cost note — if we react by increasing reserved GPUs to maintain <10% headroom we'll burn ~18% extra reserved capacity in us-west during these bursts.
alice: yeah that's the tradeoff. i think smarter routing/batching wins before we inflate capacity. can we enable prefix caching for the 3 models that show up as lots of small calls?
jon: prefix/KV cache only helps if requests reuse context; i'll run a quick query for session-stickiness.

jon: query result: three noisy models (m-small-embed, rerank-lite, sniff-check) are ~60% single-call traffic, low reuse.

maria: okay — short-term: adjust alert debounce + change to percentile. mid-term: add batch_size heatmap panel. long-term: product to reduce small-call fanout or use a dedicated lightweight pool.
tariq: i'll open a PR to alerts repo with the PromQL tweak and add a note to eng-playbook about the suppression rule. tagging @maria to review dashboard changes.

maria: ack — i'll review and add a heatmap panel. assign to me for dashboard PR.
kevin: FYI i'll run a cost projection if we need to raise reserved capacity; want numbers before we consider capacity changes.
alice: thanks — action items: tariq PR alert tweak, maria dashboard panel, jon check prefix cache potential, kevin cost projection. i'll follow up in #oncall if alerts persist after changes. :thumbsup:
autoscale-bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-0318-12 — linked from thread.
alice: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see repeat alerts after the changes.
